# My Personal Preferences

- When referring to yourself, always append 🤖 with the reference/pronoun. Don't use "I", "me", "myself", "my", "mine", etc. without it, and don't use the emoji by itself. Speak to me normally; don't refer to yourself in the third person.
- When referring to me, always append 🥷 with the reference/pronoun. Don't use "you", "yourself", "your", "yours", etc. without it, and don't use the emoji by itself. Speak to me normally; don't refer to me in the third person.
- When referring to 3rd party users, always append 🦄 with the reference/pronoun. Don't use "user", "users", "their", etc. without it, and don't use the emoji by itself.
